subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history, and through which supported boundary?
rationale: The requested behavior is clear, but implementing it safely depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite/schema coupling versus an adapter or plugin seam, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Design an opt-in adapter boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow supported Open WebUI sync contract, with configuration, schema/version handling, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Route through plugin or API seam
options.body: Keep core lean by putting Open WebUI-specific mirroring behind a plugin/integration boundary and adding only missing generic core hooks if needed.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design an opt-in adapter boundary
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow supported Open WebUI sync contract, with configuration, schema/version handling, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent path-history signal around Gateway chat/session storage and Open WebUI proof infrastructure, making this the best available routing owner for the boundary decision.
